definition: A one-year warranty costs $45.00. If the only covered failure occurs, repair costs $360.00 and the warranty pays that cost minus a $30.00 deductible. Otherwise it pays nothing. Assuming at most one failure, no other benefits or costs, and ignoring risk preferences, what failure probability makes expected payout equal the warranty price? Round to 2 decimal places.
explanation: Covered payout if failure occurs = $360.00 − $30.00 = $330.00. Set probability × $330.00 = $45.00. Break-even probability = $45.00/$330.00 × 100 = 13.64%.
